description: This file contains functions to map data structures related to task and task flow records to different view representations, including summaries, details, and aggregate summaries. It relies on imported types and functions for processing task registry data.

methods.name: export function mapTaskRunAggregateSummary(summary: TaskRegistrySummary): TaskRunAggregateSummar/ mapTaskRunAggregateSummary
methods.description: Transforms a TaskRegistrySummary object into a TaskRunAggregateSummary object, copying total, active, terminal, failures, and creating shallow copies of byStatus and byRuntime.

methods.name: export function mapTaskRunView(task: TaskRecord): TaskRunView { mapTaskRunView
methods.description: Converts a TaskRecord into a TaskRunView object, mapping fields and conditionally including optional properties based on their presence.

methods.name: export function mapTaskRunDetail(task: TaskRecord): TaskRunDetail { mapTaskRunDetail
methods.description: Returns the result of mapTaskRunView, essentially providing the same view for detailed records.

methods.name: export function mapTaskFlowView(flow: TaskFlowRecord): TaskFlowView { mapTaskFlowView
methods.description: Transforms a TaskFlowRecord into a TaskFlowView, mapping core properties and optional json fields.

methods.name: export function mapTaskFlowDetail(params: { mapTaskFlowDetail
methods.description: Constructs a TaskFlowDetail object from given flow, tasks, and optional summary, combining mapped flow data, optional JSON fields, blocked info, mapped tasks, and an aggregated task summary.
